Category: Luxury • Fabrication: DV29 - 5,000eb - 1 Month

Humanity Loss: 14 (4d6) • Install: Hospital

Neither sticks nor stones.

Iconic External Body Cyberware. Borgware. Requires 2 External Body Option Slots. Requires Skinweave, Subdermal Armor, or Dragoon Plating. All damage the user suffers after it interacts with their armor is reduced by 2, or by 4 if the Attack also inflicted a Critical Injury. Also, whenever the user’s cyberware-based armor restores SP after a set amount of time (if it does so), it restores 1 additional SP (2 SP Total).

Fabrication: DV29 - 5,000eb - 1 Month
Type: External Body Cyberware
Install: Hospital
Option Slots: uses 2

Foundry notes:

  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.
  • The price is the Luxury benchmark, for working out repairs and Tech Upgrades. Iconics can't be bought.
  • Counts as Borgware for Maximum Humanity Loss; the sheet doesn't track that, so apply it by hand.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Cyberware).
